text:
For two periods in Newark this was the kind of even, scrappy game that could have gone either way. Then a defenseman's wrist shot from the point, a 2% chance by our numbers, slipped through, and the Devils scored three times in the third to beat Washington 5-2.

New Jersey started fast. Evan Rodrigues scored on the power play 2:20 in, set up by Timo Meier and Arseny Gritsyuk. The Capitals answered on their own power play when Ryan Leonard backhanded one in off a Cole Hutson feed late in the first, and Pierre-Luc Dubois put Washington ahead early in the second, a goal that pushed their win chance to 66%. Lenni Hameenaho tied it midway through the period on a deflection. As Mike Fink of The Hockey News put it, the young Finn is "making the case to stay on the NHL roster."

The third belonged to the Devils. Vladislav Kolyachonok's point shot at 6:27 was the swing goal of the night, lifting New Jersey from 52% to 80%. Stefan Noesen added a breakaway backhand at 17:07 and Jack Hughes, coming off a week that earned him the NHL's second star, finished it at 19:15. New Jersey out-chanced Washington 2.18 to 0.89 in expected goals (the quality of chances) in that period alone, after the first two were close to level.

In net, Connor Hellebuyck was steady rather than spectacular: 26 saves on 28 shots, 0.45 goals better than expected, with his biggest stop on Hutson in the third. It has been a loud week for him. He sat out his return to Winnipeg, and he has said, per a Yahoo News Canada headline, that death threats motivated his trade request out of Canada. Logan Thompson had a harder night at the other end, allowing 1.4 goals more than his 28 shots deserved.

Overall the game was closer than the score: we gave the Devils a 54% share of replays of every shot. Washington's week has been dominated by other things, from Jakob Chychrun's hit on Nick Cousins to Alex Ovechkin's goalless run, which TSN put at 11 straight this week. New Jersey has now split the season series after losing 4-2 in October.
headline: Devils pull away late as Kolyachonok finds a seam
